     6	//
     7	// This internally uses a cross counter scheme with primary and a secondary counter, where the
     8	// secondary counter counts in reverse direction. The sum of both counters must remain constant and
     9	// equal to 2**Width-1 or otherwise an err_o will be asserted.
    10	//
    11	// This counter supports a generic clear / set / increment / decrement interface:
    12	//
    13	// clr_i: This clears the primary counter to ResetValue and adjusts the secondary counter to match
    14	//        (i.e. 2**Width-1-ResetValue). Clear has priority over set, increment and decrement.
    15	// set_i: This sets the primary counter to set_cnt_i and adjusts the secondary counter to match
    16	//        (i.e. 2**Width-1-set_cnt_i). Set has priority over increment and decrement.
    17	// incr_en_i: Increments the primary counter by step_i, and decrements the secondary by step_i.
    18	// decr_en_i: Decrements the primary counter by step_i, and increments the secondary by step_i.
    19	// commit_i: Counter changes only take effect when `commit_i` is set. This does not effect the
    20	//           `cnt_after_commit_o` output which gives the next counter state if the change is
    21	//           committed.
    22	//
    23	// Note that if both incr_en_i and decr_en_i are asserted at the same time, the counter remains
    24	// unchanged. The counter is also protected against under- and overflows.
    25	
    26	`include "prim_assert.sv"
    27	
    28	module prim_count
    29	  import prim_count_pkg::*;
    30	#(
    31	  parameter int               Width = 2,
    32	  // Can be used to reset the counter to a different value than 0, for example when
    33	  // the counter is used as a down-counter.
    34	  parameter logic [Width-1:0] ResetValue = '0,
    35	  // This should only be disabled in special circumstances, for example
    36	  // in non-comportable IPs where an error does not trigger an alert.
    37	  parameter bit               EnableAlertTriggerSVA = 1,
    38	
    39	  // We have some assertions below with preconditions that depend on particular input actions
    40	  // (clear, set, incr, decr). If the design has instantiated prim_count with one of these actions
    41	  // tied to zero, the preconditions for the associated assertions will not be satisfiable. The
    42	  // result is an unreachable item, which we treat as a failed assertion in the report.
    43	  //
    44	  // To avoid this, we the instantiation to specify the actions which might happen. If this is not
    45	  // '1, we will have an assertion which assert the corresponding action is never triggered. We can
    46	  // then use this to avoid the unreachable assertions.
    47	  parameter action_mask_t     PossibleActions = {$bits(action_mask_t){1'b1}}
    48	) (
    49	  input clk_i,
    50	  input rst_ni,
    51	  input clr_i,
    52	  input set_i,
    53	  input [Width-1:0] set_cnt_i,                 // Set value for the counter.
    54	  input incr_en_i,
    55	  input decr_en_i,
    56	  input [Width-1:0] step_i,                    // Increment/decrement step when enabled.
    57	  input commit_i,
    58	  output logic [Width-1:0] cnt_o,              // Current counter state
    59	  output logic [Width-1:0] cnt_after_commit_o, // Next counter state if committed
    60	  output logic err_o
    61	);
    62	
    63	  ///////////////////
    64	  // Counter logic //
    65	  ///////////////////
    66	
    67	  // Reset Values for primary and secondary counters.
    68	  localparam int NumCnt = 2;
    69	  localparam logic [NumCnt-1:0][Width-1:0] ResetValues = {{Width{1'b1}} - ResetValue, // secondary
    70	                                                          ResetValue};                // primary
    71	
    72	  logic [NumCnt-1:0][Width-1:0] cnt_d, cnt_d_committed, cnt_q;
    73	
    74	  // The fpv_force signal can be used in FPV runs to make the internal counters (cnt_q) jump
    75	  // unexpectedly. We only want to use this mechanism when we're doing FPV on prim_count itself. In
    76	  // that situation, we will have the PrimCountFpv define and wish to leave fpv_force undriven so
    77	  // that it becomes a free variable in FPV. In any other situation, we drive the signal with zero.
    78	  logic [NumCnt-1:0][Width-1:0] fpv_force;
    79	`ifndef PrimCountFpv
    80	  assign fpv_force = '0;
    81	`endif
    82	
    83	  for (genvar k = 0; k < NumCnt; k++) begin : gen_cnts
    84	    // Note that increments / decrements are reversed for the secondary counter.
    85	    logic incr_en, decr_en;
    86	    logic [Width-1:0] set_val;
    87	    if (k == 0) begin : gen_up_cnt
    88	      assign incr_en = incr_en_i;
    89	      assign decr_en = decr_en_i;
    90	      assign set_val = set_cnt_i;
    91	    end else begin : gen_dn_cnt
    92	      assign incr_en = decr_en_i;
    93	      assign decr_en = incr_en_i;
    94	      // The secondary value needs to be adjusted accordingly.
    95	      assign set_val = {Width{1'b1}} - set_cnt_i;
    96	    end
    97	
    98	    // Main counter logic
    99	    logic [Width:0] ext_cnt;
   100	    assign ext_cnt = (decr_en) ? {1'b0, cnt_q[k]} - {1'b0, step_i} :
   101	                     (incr_en) ? {1'b0, cnt_q[k]} + {1'b0, step_i} : {1'b0, cnt_q[k]};
   102	
   103	    // Saturation logic
   104	    logic uflow, oflow;
   105	    assign oflow = incr_en && ext_cnt[Width];
   106	    assign uflow = decr_en && ext_cnt[Width];
   107	    logic [Width-1:0] cnt_sat;
   108	    assign cnt_sat = (uflow) ? '0            :
   109	                     (oflow) ? {Width{1'b1}} : ext_cnt[Width-1:0];
   110	
   111	    // Clock gate flops when in saturation, and do not
   112	    // count if both incr_en and decr_en are asserted.
   113	    logic cnt_en;
   114	    assign cnt_en = (incr_en ^ decr_en) &&
   115	                    ((incr_en && !(&cnt_q[k])) ||
   116	                    (decr_en && !(cnt_q[k] == '0)));
   117	
   118	    // Counter muxes
   119	    assign cnt_d[k] = (clr_i)  ? ResetValues[k] :
   120	                      (set_i)  ? set_val        :
   121	                      (cnt_en) ? cnt_sat        : cnt_q[k];
   122	
   123	    assign cnt_d_committed[k] = commit_i ? cnt_d[k] : cnt_q[k];
   124	
   125	    logic [Width-1:0] cnt_unforced_q;
   126	    prim_flop #(
   127	      .Width(Width),
   128	      .ResetValue(ResetValues[k])
   129	    ) u_cnt_flop (
   130	      .clk_i,
   131	      .rst_ni,
   132	      .d_i(cnt_d_committed[k]),
   133	      .q_o(cnt_unforced_q)
   134	    );
   135	
   136	    // fpv_force is only used during FPV.
   137	    assign cnt_q[k] = fpv_force[k] + cnt_unforced_q;
   138	  end
   139	
   140	  // The sum of both counters must always equal the counter maximum.
   141	  logic [Width:0] sum;
   142	  assign sum = (cnt_q[0] + cnt_q[1]);
   143	
   144	  // Register the error signal to avoid potential CDC issues downstream.
   145	  logic err_d, err_q;
   146	  assign err_d = (sum != {1'b0, {Width{1'b1}}});
   147	  always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
   148	    if (!rst_ni) begin
   149	      err_q <= 1'b0;
   150	    end else begin
   151	      err_q <= err_d;
   152	    end
   153	  end
   154	  assign err_o = err_q;
   155	
   156	  // Output count values
   157	  assign cnt_o              = cnt_q[0];
   158	  assign cnt_after_commit_o = cnt_d[0];
   159	
   160	  ////////////////
   161	  // Assertions //
   162	  ////////////////
   163	`ifdef INC_ASSERT
   164	  //VCS coverage off
   165	  // pragma coverage off
   166	
   167	  // We need to disable most assertions in that case using a helper signal.
   168	  // We can't rely on err_o since some error patterns cannot be detected (e.g. all error
   169	  // patterns that still fulfil the sum constraint).
   170	  logic fpv_err_present;
   171	  assign fpv_err_present = |fpv_force;
   172	
   173	  // Helper functions for assertions.
   174	  function automatic logic signed [Width+1:0] max(logic signed [Width+1:0] a,
   175	                                                  logic signed [Width+1:0] b);
   176	    return (a > b) ? a : b;
   177	  endfunction
   178	
   179	  function automatic logic signed [Width+1:0] min(logic signed [Width+1:0] a,
   180	                                                  logic signed [Width+1:0] b);
   181	    return (a < b) ? a : b;
   182	  endfunction
   183	  //VCS coverage on
   184	  // pragma coverage on
   185	
   186	  if (!(PossibleActions & Clr)) begin : g_check_no_clr
   187	    `ASSERT(ClrNeverTrue_A, clr_i !== 1'b1)
   188	  end
   189	  if (!(PossibleActions & Set)) begin : g_check_no_set
   190	    `ASSERT(SetNeverTrue_A, set_i !== 1'b1)
   191	  end
   192	  if (!(PossibleActions & Incr)) begin : g_check_no_incr
   193	    `ASSERT(IncrNeverTrue_A, incr_en_i !== 1'b1)
   194	  end
   195	  if (!(PossibleActions & Decr)) begin : g_check_no_decr
   196	    `ASSERT(DecrNeverTrue_A, decr_en_i !== 1'b1)
   197	  end
   198	
   199	  // Cnt next
   200	  `ASSERT(CntNext_A,
   201	      rst_ni
   202	      |=>
   203	      $past(!commit_i) || (cnt_o == $past(cnt_after_commit_o)),
   204	      clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   205	
   206	  // Clear
   207	  if (PossibleActions & Clr) begin : g_check_clr_fwd_a
   208	    `ASSERT(ClrFwd_A,
   209	            rst_ni && commit_i && clr_i
   210	            |=>
   211	            (cnt_o == ResetValue) &&
   212	            (cnt_q[1] == ({Width{1'b1}} - ResetValue)),
   213	            clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   214	  end
   215	
   216	  // Set
   217	  if (PossibleActions & Set) begin : g_check_set_fwd_a
   218	    `ASSERT(SetFwd_A,
   219	        rst_ni && commit_i && set_i && !clr_i
   220	        |=>
   221	        (cnt_o == $past(set_cnt_i)) &&
   222	        (cnt_q[1] == ({Width{1'b1}} - $past(set_cnt_i))),
   223	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   224	  end
   225	
   226	  // Do not count if both increment and decrement are asserted.
   227	  if ((PossibleActions & Incr) && (PossibleActions & Decr)) begin : g_check_inc_and_dec
   228	    `ASSERT(IncrDecrUpDnCnt_A,
   229	        rst_ni && incr_en_i && decr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i)
   230	        |=>
   231	        $stable(cnt_o) && $stable(cnt_q[1]),
   232	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   233	  end
   234	
   235	  // Increment
   236	  if ((PossibleActions & Incr)) begin : g_check_incr
   237	    `ASSERT(IncrUpCnt_A,
   238	        rst_ni && incr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || decr_en_i) && commit_i
   239	        |=>
   240	        cnt_o == min($past(cnt_o) + $past({2'b0, step_i}), {2'b0, {Width{1'b1}}}),
   241	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   242	    `ASSERT(IncrDnCnt_A,
   243	        rst_ni && incr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || decr_en_i) && commit_i
   244	        |=>
   245	        cnt_q[1] == max($past(signed'({2'b0, cnt_q[1]})) - $past({2'b0, step_i}), '0),
   246	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   247	    `ASSERT(UpCntIncrStable_A,
   248	        incr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || decr_en_i) &&
   249	        cnt_o == {Width{1'b1}}
   250	        |=>
   251	        $stable(cnt_o),
   252	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   253	    `ASSERT(DnCntIncrStable_A,
   254	        rst_ni && incr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || decr_en_i) &&
   255	        cnt_q[1] == '0
   256	        |=>
   257	        $stable(cnt_q[1]),
   258	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   259	  end
   260	
   261	  // Decrement
   262	  if ((PossibleActions & Decr)) begin : g_check_decr
   263	    `ASSERT(DecrUpCnt_A,
   264	        rst_ni && decr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || incr_en_i) && commit_i
   265	        |=>
   266	        cnt_o == max($past(signed'({2'b0, cnt_o})) - $past({2'b0, step_i}), '0),
   267	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   268	    `ASSERT(DecrDnCnt_A,
   269	        rst_ni && decr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || incr_en_i) && commit_i
   270	        |=>
   271	        cnt_q[1] == min($past(cnt_q[1]) + $past({2'b0, step_i}), {2'b0, {Width{1'b1}}}),
   272	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   273	    `ASSERT(UpCntDecrStable_A,
   274	        decr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || incr_en_i) &&
   275	        cnt_o == '0
   276	        |=>
   277	        $stable(cnt_o),
   278	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   279	    `ASSERT(DnCntDecrStable_A,
   280	        rst_ni && decr_en_i && !(clr_i || set_i || incr_en_i) &&
   281	        cnt_q[1] == {Width{1'b1}}
   282	        |=>
   283	        $stable(cnt_q[1]),
   284	        clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   285	  end
   286	
   287	  // A backwards check for count changes. This asserts that the count only changes if one of the
   288	  // inputs that should tell it to change (clear, set, increment, decrement) does so.
   289	  `ASSERT(ChangeBackward_A,
   290	          rst_ni ##1 $changed(cnt_o) && $changed(cnt_q[1])
   291	          |->
   292	          $past(clr_i || set_i || (commit_i && (incr_en_i || decr_en_i))),
   293	          clk_i, err_d || fpv_err_present || !rst_ni)
   294	
   295	  // Check that count errors are reported properly in err_o
   296	  //
   297	  // This is essentially a "|=> implication", but is structured in a way to avoid generating a cover
   298	  // property for the left hand side if PrimCountFpv is not defined (because we won't have a way to
   299	  // inject an error if not)
   300	  `ASSERT(CntErrReported_A, ##1 $past((cnt_q[1] + cnt_q[0]) != {Width{1'b1}}) == err_o)
   301	 `ifdef PrimCountFpv
   302	  `COVER(CntErr_C, err_o)
   303	 `endif
   304	
   305	  // This logic that will be assign to one, when user adds macro
   306	  // ASSERT_PRIM_COUNT_ERROR_TRIGGER_ALERT to check the error with alert, in case that prim_count
   307	  // is used in design without adding this assertion check.
   308	  logic unused_assert_connected;
   309	
   310	  `ASSERT_INIT_NET(AssertConnected_A, unused_assert_connected === 1'b1 || !EnableAlertTriggerSVA)
   311	`endif
   312	
   313	endmodule // prim_count

     5	// Supports packed and unpacked modes
     6	// Uses FIFO timing on the control signals
     7	// No masking or flush functions supported

     9	// Timings - case where InW < OutW
    10	// clk_i      __|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__
    11	// wvalid_i   _____|~~~~|_____|~~~~|_____|~~~~|_____|~~~~|___________________
    12	// wdata_i    Val N     |Val N+1   |Val N+2   |Val N+3   |-------------------
    13	// wready_o   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~|__________|~~~~~~~~
    14	// rvalid_o   ___________________________________________|~~~~~~~~~~|________
    15	// rdata_o    -------------------------------------------|Val       |--------
    16	// rready_i   _________________________________________________|~~~~|________
    17	// depth_o    0000000000|1111111111|2222222222|3333333333|4444444444|00000000
    18	
    19	
    20	// Timings - case where InW > OutW
    21	// clk_i      __|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__
    22	// wvalid_i   _____|~~~~|____________________________________________________
    23	// wdata_i    -----|Val |----------------------------------------------------
    24	// wready_o   ~~~~~~~~~~|___________________________________________|~~~~~~~~
    25	// rvalid_o   __________|~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~|________
    26	// rdata_o    ----------|Val N     |Val N+1   |Val N+2   |Val N+3   |--------
    27	// rready_i   ________________|~~~~|_____|~~~~|_____|~~~~|_____|~~~~|________
    28	// depth_o    0000000000|4444444444|3333333333|2222222222|1111111111|00000000
    29	
    30	
    31	// Timings - case where InW = OutW
    32	// clk_i      __|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__~~|__|~~|__
    33	// wvalid_i   _____|~~~~|____________________________________________________
    34	// wdata_i    -----|Val |----------------------------------------------------
    35	// wready_o   ~~~~~~~~~~|__________|~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    36	// rvalid_o   __________|~~~~~~~~~~|_________________________________________
    37	// rdata_o    ----------|Val       |-----------------------------------------
    38	// rready_i   ________________|~~~~|_________________________________________
    39	// depth_o    0000000000|1111111111|00000000000000000000000000000000000000000
    40	
    41	
    42	`include "prim_assert.sv"
    43	
    44	module prim_packer_fifo #(
    45	  parameter int InW  = 32,
    46	  parameter int OutW = 8,
    47	  parameter bit ClearOnRead = 1'b1, // if == 1 always output 0 after read
    48	  // derived parameters
    49	  localparam int MaxW = (InW > OutW) ? InW : OutW,
    50	  localparam int MinW = (InW < OutW) ? InW : OutW,
    51	  localparam int DepthW = $clog2(MaxW/MinW)
    52	) (
    53	  input logic clk_i ,
    54	  input logic rst_ni,
    55	
    56	  input logic               clr_i,
    57	  input logic               wvalid_i,
    58	  input logic  [InW-1:0]    wdata_i,
    59	  output logic              wready_o,
    60	
    61	  output logic              rvalid_o,
    62	  output logic [OutW-1:0]   rdata_o,
    63	  input logic               rready_i,
    64	  output logic [DepthW:0]   depth_o
    65	);
    66	
    67	  localparam int unsigned   WidthRatio = MaxW / MinW;
    68	  localparam bit [DepthW:0] FullDepth = WidthRatio[DepthW:0];
    69	  localparam bit [DepthW:0] DepthOne = 1;
    70	
    71	  // signals
    72	  logic  load_data;
    73	  logic  clear_data;
    74	  logic  clear_status;
    75	
    76	  // flops
    77	  logic [DepthW:0] depth_q, depth_d;
    78	  logic [MaxW-1:0] data_q, data_d;
    79	  logic            clr_q, clr_d;
    80	
    81	  always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
    82	    if (!rst_ni) begin
    83	      depth_q <= '0;
    84	      data_q  <= '0;
    85	      clr_q   <= 1'b1;
    86	    end else begin
    87	      depth_q <= depth_d;
    88	      data_q  <= data_d;
    89	      clr_q   <= clr_d;
    90	    end
    91	  end
    92	
    93	  // flop for handling reset case for clr
    94	  assign clr_d = clr_i;
    95	
    96	  assign depth_o = depth_q;
    97	
    98	  if (InW < OutW) begin : gen_pack_mode
    99	    logic [MaxW-1:0] wdata_shifted;
   100	
   101	    assign wdata_shifted = {{OutW - InW{1'b0}}, wdata_i} << (depth_q*InW);
   102	    assign clear_status = (rready_i && rvalid_o) || clr_q;
   103	    assign clear_data = (ClearOnRead && clear_status) || clr_q;
   104	    assign load_data = wvalid_i && wready_o;
   105	
   106	    assign depth_d =  clear_status ? '0 :
   107	           load_data ? (depth_q + DepthOne):
   108	           depth_q;
   109	
   110	    assign data_d = clear_data ? '0 :
   111	           load_data ? (wdata_shifted | (depth_q == 0 ? '0 : data_q)) :
   112	           data_q;
   113	
   114	    // set outputs
   115	    assign wready_o = !(depth_q == FullDepth) && !clr_q;
   116	    assign rdata_o =  data_q;
   117	    assign rvalid_o = (depth_q == FullDepth) && !clr_q;
   118	
   119	  end else begin : gen_unpack_mode
   120	    logic [MaxW-1:0] rdata_shifted;
   121	    logic            pull_data;
   122	    logic [DepthW:0] ptr_q, ptr_d;
   123	    logic [DepthW:0] lsb_is_one;
   124	    logic [DepthW:0] max_value;
   125	
   126	    always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin
   127	      if (!rst_ni) begin
   128	        ptr_q   <= '0;
   129	      end else begin
   130	        ptr_q   <= ptr_d;
   131	      end
   132	    end
   133	
   134	    assign lsb_is_one = {{DepthW{1'b0}},1'b1};
   135	    assign max_value = FullDepth;
   136	    assign rdata_shifted = data_q >> ptr_q*OutW;
   137	    assign clear_status = (rready_i && (depth_q == lsb_is_one)) || clr_q;
   138	    assign clear_data = (ClearOnRead && clear_status) || clr_q;
   139	    assign load_data = wvalid_i && wready_o;
   140	    assign pull_data = rvalid_o && rready_i;
   141	
   142	    assign depth_d =  clear_status ? '0 :
   143	           load_data ? max_value :
   144	           pull_data ? (depth_q - DepthOne) :
   145	           depth_q;
   146	
   147	    assign ptr_d =  clear_status ? '0 :
   148	           pull_data ? (ptr_q + DepthOne) :
   149	           ptr_q;
   150	
   151	    assign data_d = clear_data ? '0 :
   152	           load_data ? wdata_i :
   153	           data_q;
   154	
   155	    // set outputs
   156	    assign wready_o = (depth_q == '0) && !clr_q;
   157	    assign rdata_o =  rdata_shifted[OutW-1:0];
   158	    assign rvalid_o = !(depth_q == '0) && !clr_q;
   159	
   160	    // Avoid possible lint errors in case InW > OutW.
   161	    if (InW > OutW) begin : gen_unused
   162	      logic [MaxW-MinW-1:0] unused_rdata_shifted;

    32	    input  dtype  data_i,           // data to push into the queue
    33	    input  logic  push_i,           // data is valid and can be pushed to the queue

    44	    logic [ADDR_DEPTH - 1:0] read_pointer_n, read_pointer_q, write_pointer_n, write_pointer_q;

    46	    // this integer will be truncated by the synthesis tool

    49	    dtype [FifoDepth - 1:0] mem_n, mem_q;

    18	/// The rr_arb_tree employs non-starving round robin-arbitration - i.e., the priorities
    19	/// rotate each cycle.
    20	///
    21	/// ## Fair vs. unfair Arbitration
    22	///
    23	/// This refers to fair throughput distribution when not all inputs have active requests.
    24	/// This module has an internal state `rr_q` which defines the highest priority input. (When
    25	/// `ExtPrio` is `1'b1` this state is provided from the outside.) The arbitration tree will
    26	/// choose the input with the same index as currently defined by the state if it has an active
    27	/// request. Otherwise a *random* other active input is selected. The parameter `FairArb` is used
    28	/// to distinguish between two methods of calculating the next state.
    29	/// * `1'b0`: The next state is calculated by advancing the current state by one. This leads to the
    30	///           state being calculated without the context of the active request. Leading to an
    31	///           unfair throughput distribution if not all inputs have active requests.
    32	/// * `1'b1`: The next state jumps to the next unserved request with higher index.
    33	///           This is achieved by using two trailing-zero-counters (`lzc`). The upper has the masked
    34	///           `req_i` signal with all indices which will have a higher priority in the next state.
    35	///           The trailing zero count defines the input index with the next highest priority after
    36	///           the current one is served. When the upper is empty the lower `lzc` provides the
    37	///           wrapped index if there are outstanding requests with lower or same priority.
    38	/// The implication of throughput fairness on the module timing are:
    39	/// * The trailing zero counter (`lzc`) has a loglog relation of input to output timing. This means
    40	///   that in this module the input to register path scales with Log(Log(`NumIn`)).
    41	/// * The `rr_arb_tree` data multiplexing scales with Log(`NumIn`). This means that the input to output
    42	///   timing path of this module also scales scales with Log(`NumIn`).
    43	/// This implies that in this module the input to output path is always longer than the input to
    44	/// register path. As the output data usually also terminates in a register the parameter `FairArb`
    45	/// only has implications on the area. When it is `1'b0` a static plus one adder is instantiated.
    46	/// If it is `1'b1` two `lzc`, a masking logic stage and a two input multiplexer are instantiated.
    47	/// However these are small in respect of the data multiplexers needed, as the width of the `req_i`
    48	/// signal is usually less as than `DataWidth`.

    50	  /// Number of inputs to be arbitrated.
    51	  parameter int unsigned NumIn      = 64,
    52	  /// Data width of the payload in bits. Not needed if `DataType` is overwritten.
    53	  parameter int unsigned DataWidth  = 32,
    54	  /// Data type of the payload, can be overwritten with custom type. Only use of `DataWidth`.

    57	  /// `rr_i` signal. This can be useful in case multiple arbiters need to have
    58	  /// rotating priorities that are operating in lock-step. If static priority arbitration

    68	  /// Set to `1'b1` to treat req/gnt as vld/rdy.

    74	  ///
    75	  /// Set to `1'b1` to enable.
    76	  parameter bit          LockIn     = 1'b0,
    77	  /// When set, ensures that throughput gets distributed evenly between all inputs.

    79	  /// Set to `1'b0` to disable.

    83	  parameter int unsigned IdxWidth   = (NumIn > 32'd1) ? unsigned'($clog2(NumIn)) : 32'd1,

   159	              lock_q <= '0;
   160	            end else begin
   161	              lock_q <= lock_d;
   162	            end
   163	          end
   164	        end
   165	
   166	        `ifndef COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF
   167	          `ASSERT(lock, req_o && (!gnt_i && !flush_i) |=> idx_o == $past(idx_o),
   168	                  clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   169	                  "Lock implies same arbiter decision in next cycle if output is not ready.")
   170	
   171	          logic [NumIn-1:0] req_tmp;
   172	          assign req_tmp = req_q & req_i;
   173	          `ASSUME(lock_req, lock_d |=> req_tmp == req_q, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   174	                  "It is disallowed to deassert unserved request signals when LockIn is enabled.")
   175	        `endif
   176	
   177	        always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin : p_req_regs
   178	          if (!rst_ni) begin
   179	            req_q  <= '0;
   180	          end else begin
   181	            if (flush_i) begin
   182	              req_q  <= '0;
   183	            end else begin
   184	              req_q  <= req_d;
   185	            end
   186	          end
   187	        end
   188	      end else begin : gen_no_lock
   189	        assign req_d = req_i;
   190	      end
   191	
   192	      if (FairArb) begin : gen_fair_arb
   193	        logic [NumIn-1:0] upper_mask,  lower_mask;
   194	        idx_t             upper_idx,   lower_idx,   next_idx;
   195	        logic             upper_empty, lower_empty;
   196	
   197	        for (genvar i = 0; i < NumIn; i++) begin : gen_mask
   198	          assign upper_mask[i] = (i >  rr_q) ? req_d[i] : 1'b0;
   199	          assign lower_mask[i] = (i <= rr_q) ? req_d[i] : 1'b0;
   200	        end
   201	
   202	        lzc #(
   203	          .WIDTH ( NumIn ),
   204	          .MODE  ( 1'b0  )
   205	        ) i_lzc_upper (
   206	          .in_i    ( upper_mask  ),
   207	          .cnt_o   ( upper_idx   ),
   208	          .empty_o ( upper_empty )
   209	        );
   210	
   211	        lzc #(
   212	          .WIDTH ( NumIn ),
   213	          .MODE  ( 1'b0  )
   214	        ) i_lzc_lower (
   215	          .in_i    ( lower_mask  ),
   216	          .cnt_o   ( lower_idx   ),
   217	          .empty_o ( /*unused*/  )
   218	        );
   219	
   220	        assign next_idx = upper_empty      ? lower_idx : upper_idx;
   221	        assign rr_d     = (gnt_i && req_o) ? next_idx  : rr_q;
   222	
   223	      end else begin : gen_unfair_arb
   224	        assign rr_d = (gnt_i && req_o) ? ((rr_q == idx_t'(NumIn-1)) ? '0 : rr_q + 1'b1) : rr_q;
   225	      end
   226	
   227	      // this holds the highest priority
   228	      always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin : p_rr_regs
   229	        if (!rst_ni) begin
   230	          rr_q   <= '0;
   231	        end else begin
   232	          if (flush_i) begin
   233	            rr_q   <= '0;
   234	          end else begin
   235	            rr_q   <= rr_d;
   236	          end
   237	        end
   238	      end
   239	    end
   240	
   241	    assign gnt_nodes[0] = gnt_i;
   242	
   243	    // arbiter tree
   244	    for (genvar level = 0; unsigned'(level) < NumLevels; level++) begin : gen_levels
   245	      for (genvar l = 0; l < 2**level; l++) begin : gen_level
   246	        // local select signal
   247	        logic sel;
   248	        // index calcs
   249	        localparam int unsigned Idx0 = 2**level-1+l;// current node
   250	        localparam int unsigned Idx1 = 2**(level+1)-1+l*2;
   251	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   252	        // uppermost level where data is fed in from the inputs
   253	        if (unsigned'(level) == NumLevels-1) begin : gen_first_level
   254	          // if two successive indices are still in the vector...
   255	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 < NumIn-1) begin : gen_reduce
   256	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_d[l*2] | req_d[l*2+1];
   257	
   258	            // arbitration: round robin
   259	            assign sel =  ~req_d[l*2] | req_d[l*2+1] & rr_q[NumLevels-1-level];
   260	
   261	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = idx_t'(sel);
   262	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = (sel) ? data_i[l*2+1] : data_i[l*2];
   263	            assign gnt_o[l*2]        = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2])   & ~sel;
   264	            assign gnt_o[l*2+1]      = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2+1]) & sel;
   265	          end
   266	          // if only the first index is still in the vector...
   267	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 == NumIn-1) begin : gen_first
   268	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_d[l*2];
   269	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = '0;// always zero in this case
   270	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = data_i[l*2];
   271	            assign gnt_o[l*2]        = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2]);
   272	          end
   273	          // if index is out of range, fill up with zeros (will get pruned)
   274	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 > NumIn-1) begin : gen_out_of_range
   275	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = 1'b0;
   276	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = idx_t'('0);
   277	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = DataType'('0);
   278	          end
   279	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   280	        // general case for other levels within the tree
   281	        end else begin : gen_other_levels
   282	          assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_nodes[Idx1] | req_nodes[Idx1+1];
   283	
   284	          // arbitration: round robin
   285	          assign sel =  ~req_nodes[Idx1] | req_nodes[Idx1+1] & rr_q[NumLevels-1-level];
   286	
   287	          assign index_nodes[Idx0] = (sel) ?
   288	            idx_t'({1'b1, index_nodes[Idx1+1][NumLevels-unsigned'(level)-2:0]}) :
   289	            idx_t'({1'b0, index_nodes[Idx1][NumLevels-unsigned'(level)-2:0]});
   290	
   291	          assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = (sel) ? data_nodes[Idx1+1] : data_nodes[Idx1];
   292	          assign gnt_nodes[Idx1]   = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & ~sel;
   293	          assign gnt_nodes[Idx1+1] = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & sel;
   294	        end
   295	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   296	      end
   297	    end
   298	
   299	    `ifndef COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF
   300	    `ASSERT_INIT(numin_0, NumIn, "Input must be at least one element wide.")
   301	    `ASSERT_INIT(lockin_and_extprio, !(LockIn && ExtPrio),
   302	                 "Cannot use LockIn feature together with external ExtPrio.")
   303	
   304	    `ASSERT(hot_one, $onehot0(gnt_o), clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   305	            "Grant signal must be hot1 or zero.")
   306	
   307	    `ASSERT(gnt0, |gnt_o |-> gnt_i, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i, "Grant out implies grant in.")
   308	
   309	    `ASSERT(gnt1, req_o |-> gnt_i |-> |gnt_o, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   310	            "Req out and grant in implies grant out.")
   311	
   312	    `ASSERT(gnt_idx, req_o |->  gnt_i |-> gnt_o[idx_o], clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i,
   313	            "Idx_o / gnt_o do not match.")
   314	
   315	    `ASSERT(req0, |req_i |-> req_o, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i, "Req in implies req out.")
   316	
   317	    `ASSERT(req1, req_o |-> |req_i, clk_i, !rst_ni || flush_i, "Req out implies req in.")
   318	    `endif
   319	  end
   320	
   321	endmodule : rr_arb_tree

    27	`resetall

    31	/*
    32	 * AXI4-Stream register
    33	 */
    34	module axis_register #
    35	(
    36	    // Width of AXI stream interfaces in bits
    37	    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
    38	    // Propagate tkeep signal
    39	    parameter KEEP_ENABLE = (DATA_WIDTH>8),
    40	    // tkeep signal width (words per cycle)
    41	    parameter KEEP_WIDTH = ((DATA_WIDTH+7)/8),
    42	    // Propagate tlast signal
    43	    parameter LAST_ENABLE = 1,
    44	    // Propagate tid signal
    45	    parameter ID_ENABLE = 0,
    46	    // tid signal width
    47	    parameter ID_WIDTH = 8,
    48	    // Propagate tdest signal
    49	    parameter DEST_ENABLE = 0,
    50	    // tdest signal width
    51	    parameter DEST_WIDTH = 8,
    52	    // Propagate tuser signal
    53	    parameter USER_ENABLE = 1,
    54	    // tuser signal width
    55	    parameter USER_WIDTH = 1,
    56	    // Register type
    57	    // 0 to bypass, 1 for simple buffer, 2 for skid buffer
    58	    parameter REG_TYPE = 2
    59	)
    60	(
    61	    input  wire                   clk,
    62	    input  wire                   rst,
    63	
    64	    /*
    65	     * AXI Stream input
    66	     */
    67	    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tdata,
    68	    input  wire [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tkeep,
    69	    input  wire                   s_axis_tvalid,
    70	    output wire                   s_axis_tready,
    71	    input  wire                   s_axis_tlast,
    72	    input  wire [ID_WIDTH-1:0]    s_axis_tid,
    73	    input  wire [DEST_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tdest,
    74	    input  wire [USER_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tuser,
    75	
    76	    /*
    77	     * AXI Stream output
    78	     */
    79	    output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tdata,
    80	    output wire [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tkeep,
    81	    output wire                   m_axis_tvalid,
    82	    input  wire                   m_axis_tready,
    83	    output wire                   m_axis_tlast,
    84	    output wire [ID_WIDTH-1:0]    m_axis_tid,
    85	    output wire [DEST_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tdest,
    86	    output wire [USER_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tuser
    87	);
    88	
    89	generate
    90	
    91	if (REG_TYPE > 1) begin
    92	    // skid buffer, no bubble cycles
    93	
    94	    // datapath registers
    95	    reg                  s_axis_tready_reg = 1'b0;
    96	
    97	    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata_reg  = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
    98	    reg [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tkeep_reg  = {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b0}};
    99	    reg                  m_axis_tvalid_reg = 1'b0, m_axis_tvalid_next;
   100	    reg                  m_axis_tlast_reg  = 1'b0;
   101	    reg [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   m_axis_tid_reg    = {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   102	    reg [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdest_reg  = {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   103	    reg [USER_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tuser_reg  = {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   104	
   105	    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] temp_m_axis_tdata_reg  = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   106	    reg [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] temp_m_axis_tkeep_reg  = {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   107	    reg                  temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg = 1'b0, temp_m_axis_tvalid_next;
   108	    reg                  temp_m_axis_tlast_reg  = 1'b0;
   109	    reg [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   temp_m_axis_tid_reg    = {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   110	    reg [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] temp_m_axis_tdest_reg  = {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   111	    reg [USER_WIDTH-1:0] temp_m_axis_tuser_reg  = {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   112	
   113	    // datapath control
   114	    reg store_axis_input_to_output;
   115	    reg store_axis_input_to_temp;
   116	    reg store_axis_temp_to_output;
   117	
   118	    assign s_axis_tready = s_axis_tready_reg;
   119	
   120	    assign m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_tdata_reg;
   121	    assign m_axis_tkeep  = KEEP_ENABLE ? m_axis_tkeep_reg : {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}};
   122	    assign m_axis_tvalid = m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   123	    assign m_axis_tlast  = LAST_ENABLE ? m_axis_tlast_reg : 1'b1;
   124	    assign m_axis_tid    = ID_ENABLE   ? m_axis_tid_reg   : {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   125	    assign m_axis_tdest  = DEST_ENABLE ? m_axis_tdest_reg : {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   126	    assign m_axis_tuser  = USER_ENABLE ? m_axis_tuser_reg : {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   127	
   128	    // enable ready input next cycle if output is ready or the temp reg will not be filled on the next cycle (output reg empty or no input)
   129	    wire s_axis_tready_early = m_axis_tready || (!temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg && (!m_axis_tvalid_reg || !s_axis_tvalid));
   130	
   131	    always @* begin
   132	        // transfer sink ready state to source
   133	        m_axis_tvalid_next = m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   134	        temp_m_axis_tvalid_next = temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   135	
   136	        store_axis_input_to_output = 1'b0;
   137	        store_axis_input_to_temp = 1'b0;
   138	        store_axis_temp_to_output = 1'b0;
   139	
   140	        if (s_axis_tready_reg) begin
   141	            // input is ready
   142	            if (m_axis_tready || !m_axis_tvalid_reg) begin
   143	                // output is ready or currently not valid, transfer data to output
   144	                m_axis_tvalid_next = s_axis_tvalid;
   145	                store_axis_input_to_output = 1'b1;
   146	            end else begin
   147	                // output is not ready, store input in temp
   148	                temp_m_axis_tvalid_next = s_axis_tvalid;
   149	                store_axis_input_to_temp = 1'b1;
   150	            end
   151	        end else if (m_axis_tready) begin
   152	            // input is not ready, but output is ready
   153	            m_axis_tvalid_next = temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   154	            temp_m_axis_tvalid_next = 1'b0;
   155	            store_axis_temp_to_output = 1'b1;
   156	        end
   157	    end
   158	
   159	    always @(posedge clk) begin
   160	        s_axis_tready_reg <= s_axis_tready_early;
   161	        m_axis_tvalid_reg <= m_axis_tvalid_next;
   162	        temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg <= temp_m_axis_tvalid_next;
   163	
   164	        // datapath
   165	        if (store_axis_input_to_output) begin
   166	            m_axis_tdata_reg <= s_axis_tdata;
   167	            m_axis_tkeep_reg <= s_axis_tkeep;
   168	            m_axis_tlast_reg <= s_axis_tlast;
   169	            m_axis_tid_reg   <= s_axis_tid;
   170	            m_axis_tdest_reg <= s_axis_tdest;
   171	            m_axis_tuser_reg <= s_axis_tuser;
   172	        end else if (store_axis_temp_to_output) begin
   173	            m_axis_tdata_reg <= temp_m_axis_tdata_reg;
   174	            m_axis_tkeep_reg <= temp_m_axis_tkeep_reg;
   175	            m_axis_tlast_reg <= temp_m_axis_tlast_reg;
   176	            m_axis_tid_reg   <= temp_m_axis_tid_reg;
   177	            m_axis_tdest_reg <= temp_m_axis_tdest_reg;
   178	            m_axis_tuser_reg <= temp_m_axis_tuser_reg;
   179	        end
   180	
   181	        if (store_axis_input_to_temp) begin
   182	            temp_m_axis_tdata_reg <= s_axis_tdata;
   183	            temp_m_axis_tkeep_reg <= s_axis_tkeep;
   184	            temp_m_axis_tlast_reg <= s_axis_tlast;
   185	            temp_m_axis_tid_reg   <= s_axis_tid;
   186	            temp_m_axis_tdest_reg <= s_axis_tdest;
   187	            temp_m_axis_tuser_reg <= s_axis_tuser;
   188	        end
   189	
   190	        if (rst) begin
   191	            s_axis_tready_reg <= 1'b0;
   192	            m_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b0;
   193	            temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b0;
   194	        end
   195	    end
   196	
   197	end else if (REG_TYPE == 1) begin
   198	    // simple register, inserts bubble cycles
   199	
   200	    // datapath registers
   201	    reg                  s_axis_tready_reg = 1'b0;
   202	
   203	    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata_reg  = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   204	    reg [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tkeep_reg  = {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   205	    reg                  m_axis_tvalid_reg = 1'b0, m_axis_tvalid_next;
   206	    reg                  m_axis_tlast_reg  = 1'b0;
   207	    reg [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   m_axis_tid_reg    = {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   208	    reg [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdest_reg  = {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   209	    reg [USER_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tuser_reg  = {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   210	
   211	    // datapath control
   212	    reg store_axis_input_to_output;
   213	
   214	    assign s_axis_tready = s_axis_tready_reg;
   215	
   216	    assign m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_tdata_reg;
   217	    assign m_axis_tkeep  = KEEP_ENABLE ? m_axis_tkeep_reg : {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}};
   218	    assign m_axis_tvalid = m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   219	    assign m_axis_tlast  = LAST_ENABLE ? m_axis_tlast_reg : 1'b1;
   220	    assign m_axis_tid    = ID_ENABLE   ? m_axis_tid_reg   : {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   221	    assign m_axis_tdest  = DEST_ENABLE ? m_axis_tdest_reg : {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   222	    assign m_axis_tuser  = USER_ENABLE ? m_axis_tuser_reg : {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   223	
   224	    // enable ready input next cycle if output buffer will be empty
   225	    wire s_axis_tready_early = !m_axis_tvalid_next;
   226	
   227	    always @* begin
   228	        // transfer sink ready state to source
   229	        m_axis_tvalid_next = m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   230	
   231	        store_axis_input_to_output = 1'b0;
   232	
   233	        if (s_axis_tready_reg) begin
   234	            m_axis_tvalid_next = s_axis_tvalid;
   235	            store_axis_input_to_output = 1'b1;
   236	        end else if (m_axis_tready) begin
   237	            m_axis_tvalid_next = 1'b0;
   238	        end
   239	    end
   240	
   241	    always @(posedge clk) begin
   242	        s_axis_tready_reg <= s_axis_tready_early;
   243	        m_axis_tvalid_reg <= m_axis_tvalid_next;
   244	
   245	        // datapath
   246	        if (store_axis_input_to_output) begin
   247	            m_axis_tdata_reg <= s_axis_tdata;
   248	            m_axis_tkeep_reg <= s_axis_tkeep;
   249	            m_axis_tlast_reg <= s_axis_tlast;
   250	            m_axis_tid_reg   <= s_axis_tid;
   251	            m_axis_tdest_reg <= s_axis_tdest;
   252	            m_axis_tuser_reg <= s_axis_tuser;
   253	        end
   254	
   255	        if (rst) begin
   256	            s_axis_tready_reg <= 1'b0;
   257	            m_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b0;
   258	        end
   259	    end
   260	
   261	end else begin
   262	    // bypass
   263	
   264	    assign m_axis_tdata  = s_axis_tdata;
   265	    assign m_axis_tkeep  = KEEP_ENABLE ? s_axis_tkeep : {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}};
   266	    assign m_axis_tvalid = s_axis_tvalid;
   267	    assign m_axis_tlast  = LAST_ENABLE ? s_axis_tlast : 1'b1;
   268	    assign m_axis_tid    = ID_ENABLE   ? s_axis_tid   : {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   269	    assign m_axis_tdest  = DEST_ENABLE ? s_axis_tdest : {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   270	    assign m_axis_tuser  = USER_ENABLE ? s_axis_tuser : {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   271	
   272	    assign s_axis_tready = m_axis_tready;
   273	
   274	end
   275	
   276	endgenerate
   277	
   278	endmodule

    34	module axis_pipeline_fifo #
    35	(
    36	    // Width of AXI stream interfaces in bits
    37	    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
    38	    // Propagate tkeep signal
    39	    parameter KEEP_ENABLE = (DATA_WIDTH>8),
    40	    // tkeep signal width (words per cycle)
    41	    parameter KEEP_WIDTH = ((DATA_WIDTH+7)/8),
    42	    // Propagate tlast signal

    44	    // Propagate tid signal
    45	    parameter ID_ENABLE = 0,

    47	    parameter ID_WIDTH = 8,
    48	    // Propagate tdest signal
    49	    parameter DEST_ENABLE = 0,
    50	    // tdest signal width
    51	    parameter DEST_WIDTH = 8,
    52	    // Propagate tuser signal
    53	    parameter USER_ENABLE = 1,
    54	    // tuser signal width
    55	    parameter USER_WIDTH = 1,
    56	    // Number of registers in pipeline
    57	    parameter LENGTH = 2
    58	)
    59	(
    60	    input  wire                   clk,
    61	    input  wire                   rst,
    62	
    63	    /*
    64	     * AXI input
    65	     */
    66	    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tdata,
    67	    input  wire [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tkeep,
    68	    input  wire                   s_axis_tvalid,
    69	    output wire                   s_axis_tready,
    70	    input  wire                   s_axis_tlast,
    71	    input  wire [ID_WIDTH-1:0]    s_axis_tid,
    72	    input  wire [DEST_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tdest,
    73	    input  wire [USER_WIDTH-1:0]  s_axis_tuser,
    74	
    75	    /*
    76	     * AXI output
    77	     */
    78	    output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tdata,
    79	    output wire [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tkeep,
    80	    output wire                   m_axis_tvalid,
    81	    input  wire                   m_axis_tready,
    82	    output wire                   m_axis_tlast,
    83	    output wire [ID_WIDTH-1:0]    m_axis_tid,
    84	    output wire [DEST_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tdest,
    85	    output wire [USER_WIDTH-1:0]  m_axis_tuser
    86	);
    87	
    88	parameter FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH = LENGTH < 2 ? 3 : $clog2(LENGTH*4+1);
    89	
    90	wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] axis_tdata_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    91	wire [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] axis_tkeep_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    92	wire                  axis_tvalid_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    93	wire                  axis_tready_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    94	wire                  axis_tlast_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    95	wire [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   axis_tid_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    96	wire [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] axis_tdest_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    97	wire [USER_WIDTH-1:0] axis_tuser_pipe[0:LENGTH];
    98	
    99	generate
   100	
   101	genvar n;
   102	
   103	for (n = 0; n < LENGTH; n = n + 1) begin : stage
   104	
   105	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   106	    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]  axis_tdata_reg = 0;
   107	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   108	    reg [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0]  axis_tkeep_reg = 0;
   109	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   110	    reg                   axis_tvalid_reg = 0;
   111	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   112	    reg                   axis_tready_reg = 0;
   113	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   114	    reg                   axis_tlast_reg = 0;
   115	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   116	    reg [ID_WIDTH-1:0]    axis_tid_reg = 0;
   117	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   118	    reg [DEST_WIDTH-1:0]  axis_tdest_reg = 0;
   119	    (* shreg_extract = "no" *)
   120	    reg [USER_WIDTH-1:0]  axis_tuser_reg = 0;
   121	
   122	    assign axis_tdata_pipe[n+1] = axis_tdata_reg;
   123	    assign axis_tkeep_pipe[n+1] = axis_tkeep_reg;
   124	    assign axis_tvalid_pipe[n+1] = axis_tvalid_reg;
   125	    assign axis_tlast_pipe[n+1] = axis_tlast_reg;
   126	    assign axis_tid_pipe[n+1] = axis_tid_reg;
   127	    assign axis_tdest_pipe[n+1] = axis_tdest_reg;
   128	    assign axis_tuser_pipe[n+1] = axis_tuser_reg;
   129	
   130	    assign axis_tready_pipe[n] = axis_tready_reg;

   132	    always @(posedge clk) begin
   133	        axis_tdata_reg <= axis_tdata_pipe[n];
   134	        axis_tkeep_reg <= axis_tkeep_pipe[n];
   135	        axis_tvalid_reg <= axis_tvalid_pipe[n];
   136	        axis_tlast_reg <= axis_tlast_pipe[n];
   137	        axis_tid_reg <= axis_tid_pipe[n];
   138	        axis_tdest_reg <= axis_tdest_pipe[n];
   139	        axis_tuser_reg <= axis_tuser_pipe[n];

   141	        axis_tready_reg <= axis_tready_pipe[n+1];

   145	            axis_tready_reg <= 1'b0;

   147	    end

   149	end

   152	
   153	    assign axis_tdata_pipe[0] = s_axis_tdata;
   154	    assign axis_tkeep_pipe[0] = s_axis_tkeep;
   155	    assign axis_tvalid_pipe[0] = s_axis_tvalid & s_axis_tready;
   156	    assign axis_tlast_pipe[0] = s_axis_tlast;
   157	    assign axis_tid_pipe[0] = s_axis_tid;
   158	    assign axis_tdest_pipe[0] = s_axis_tdest;
   159	    assign axis_tuser_pipe[0] = s_axis_tuser;
   160	    assign s_axis_tready = axis_tready_pipe[0];
   161	
   162	    wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata_int = axis_tdata_pipe[LENGTH];
   163	    wire [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tkeep_int = axis_tkeep_pipe[LENGTH];
   164	    wire                  m_axis_tvalid_int = axis_tvalid_pipe[LENGTH];
   165	    wire                  m_axis_tready_int;
   166	    wire                  m_axis_tlast_int = axis_tlast_pipe[LENGTH];
   167	    wire [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   m_axis_tid_int = axis_tid_pipe[LENGTH];
   168	    wire [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdest_int = axis_tdest_pipe[LENGTH];
   169	    wire [USER_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tuser_int = axis_tuser_pipe[LENGTH];
   170	
   171	    assign axis_tready_pipe[LENGTH] = m_axis_tready_int;
   172	
   173	    // output datapath logic
   174	    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata_reg  = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   175	    reg [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tkeep_reg  = {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   176	    reg                  m_axis_tvalid_reg = 1'b0;
   177	    reg                  m_axis_tlast_reg  = 1'b0;
   178	    reg [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   m_axis_tid_reg    = {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   179	    reg [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdest_reg  = {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   180	    reg [USER_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tuser_reg  = {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};

   183	    reg [FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH+1-1:0] out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg = 0;
   184	    reg out_fifo_half_full_reg = 1'b0;
   185	
   186	    wire out_fifo_full = out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg == (out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg ^ {1'b1, {FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}}});

   189	    (* ram_style = "distributed", ramstyle = "no_rw_check, mlab" *)
   190	    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] out_fifo_tdata[2**FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
   191	    (* ram_style = "distributed", ramstyle = "no_rw_check, mlab" *)
   192	    reg [KEEP_WIDTH-1:0] out_fifo_tkeep[2**FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
   193	    (* ram_style = "distributed", ramstyle = "no_rw_check, mlab" *)
   194	    reg                  out_fifo_tlast[2**FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
   195	    (* ram_style = "distributed", ramstyle = "no_rw_check, mlab" *)
   196	    reg [ID_WIDTH-1:0]   out_fifo_tid[2**FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
   197	    (* ram_style = "distributed", ramstyle = "no_rw_check, mlab" *)
   198	    reg [DEST_WIDTH-1:0] out_fifo_tdest[2**FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
   199	    (* ram_style = "distributed", ramstyle = "no_rw_check, mlab" *)
   200	    reg [USER_WIDTH-1:0] out_fifo_tuser[2**FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
   201	
   202	    assign m_axis_tready_int = !out_fifo_half_full_reg;
   203	
   204	    assign m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_tdata_reg;
   205	    assign m_axis_tkeep  = KEEP_ENABLE ? m_axis_tkeep_reg : {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}};
   206	    assign m_axis_tvalid = m_axis_tvalid_reg;
   207	    assign m_axis_tlast  = LAST_ENABLE ? m_axis_tlast_reg : 1'b1;
   208	    assign m_axis_tid    = ID_ENABLE   ? m_axis_tid_reg   : {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   209	    assign m_axis_tdest  = DEST_ENABLE ? m_axis_tdest_reg : {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   210	    assign m_axis_tuser  = USER_ENABLE ? m_axis_tuser_reg : {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   211	
   212	    always @(posedge clk) begin
   213	        m_axis_tvalid_reg <= m_axis_tvalid_reg && !m_axis_tready;
   214	
   215	        out_fifo_half_full_reg <= $unsigned(out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg - out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg) >= 2**(FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1);
   216	
   217	        if (!out_fifo_full && m_axis_tvalid_int) begin
   218	            out_fifo_tdata[out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= m_axis_tdata_int;
   219	            out_fifo_tkeep[out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= m_axis_tkeep_int;
   220	            out_fifo_tlast[out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= m_axis_tlast_int;
   221	            out_fifo_tid[out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= m_axis_tid_int;
   222	            out_fifo_tdest[out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= m_axis_tdest_int;
   223	            out_fifo_tuser[out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= m_axis_tuser_int;
   224	            out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg <= out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg + 1;
   225	        end
   226	
   227	        if (!out_fifo_empty && (!m_axis_tvalid_reg || m_axis_tready)) begin
   228	            m_axis_tdata_reg <= out_fifo_tdata[out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   229	            m_axis_tkeep_reg <= out_fifo_tkeep[out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   230	            m_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b1;
   231	            m_axis_tlast_reg <= out_fifo_tlast[out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   232	            m_axis_tid_reg <= out_fifo_tid[out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   233	            m_axis_tdest_reg <= out_fifo_tdest[out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   234	            m_axis_tuser_reg <= out_fifo_tuser[out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg[FIFO_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]];
   235	            out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg <= out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg + 1;
   236	        end
   237	
   238	        if (rst) begin
   239	            out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg <= 0;
   240	            out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg <= 0;
   241	            m_axis_tvalid_reg <= 1'b0;
   242	        end
   243	    end
   244	
   245	end else begin
   246	    // bypass
   247	
   248	    assign m_axis_tdata  = s_axis_tdata;
   249	    assign m_axis_tkeep  = KEEP_ENABLE ? s_axis_tkeep : {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}};
   250	    assign m_axis_tvalid = s_axis_tvalid;
   251	    assign m_axis_tlast  = LAST_ENABLE ? s_axis_tlast : 1'b1;
   252	    assign m_axis_tid    = ID_ENABLE   ? s_axis_tid   : {ID_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   253	    assign m_axis_tdest  = DEST_ENABLE ? s_axis_tdest : {DEST_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   254	    assign m_axis_tuser  = USER_ENABLE ? s_axis_tuser : {USER_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   255	
   256	    assign s_axis_tready = m_axis_tready;

   258	end
